name: What materials work best for outdoor kitchens in coastal climates?

mainEntity.name: What materials work best for outdoor kitchens in coastal climates?

acceptedAnswer.text: Marine-grade stainless steel appliances, concrete countertops with sealed surfaces, cedar or composite cabinetry, and stacked stone accents withstand sun, salt air, and temperature swings.
